resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Lake County list records the owner as Mn MFS but also says the tower may have been given over to the U.S. Forest Service. We found no record of a transfer.

notes_for_editor: Build year, height and type come from two county lists that agree; the FFLA and the Lake County list both record removal. No staffing or fire history in sources. No source describes the site today or its access. A 2021 Greenwood Fire began near Greenwood Lake (Wikipedia search snippet); no source ties it to the tower, so not used. Tower number 142 is the state number in the county list.
